home_meta_title: LM Deck Tools — Chart Your Own Course
home_meta_description: Manage your Magic: The Gathering card lists and collection. Every plank of data stays on your device — no accounts, no servers, no middlemen.
home_eyebrow: No captain · No port · Your treasure
home_hero_subtitle: Manage your Magic: The Gathering card lists and collection. Every plank of data stays on your device — no accounts, no servers, no middlemen.
home_feature_lists_body: Create and manage named card lists. Search Scryfall's full catalogue and cross-reference ownership against your collection.
home_feature_hoard_body: Keep an inventory of every card you own. See at a glance what's in your hold and what you need to complete your lists.
home_feature_portability_body: Move data freely. Plain text in, plain text out. Share lists with your crew or stash a backup — your treasure, your rules.
home_step1_body: Add cards you own to your collection. Search or import in bulk.
home_step2_body: Build lists searching Scryfall. Ownership shows automatically.
home_step3_body: See which lists are complete and which cards you still need.
home_step4_body: Export plain text to share, trade, or backup your data.
home_compact_lead: We built this tool on the same principles that governed the fairest ships on the sea —
home_compact_lead_strong: transparency in every process, no central authority, and every hand sovereign over their own treasure.
home_article_1_title: Your data never leaves your device.
home_article_1_body: No server, no cloud, no third-party databases.
home_article_2_body: We don't know who you are and we don't want to.
home_article_3_body: Export anytime. Your collection is yours to take wherever you sail.
home_article_4_body: Every plank of this ship is visible. No hidden compartments.

diagnostics_meta_description: Errors this app recorded on your device. Read them, export them, or open a pre-filled GitHub issue — nothing leaves your device on its own.
diagnostics_intro: Errors this app ran into, recorded on your device and nowhere else. Nothing here is sent anywhere unless you export it or choose to open a GitHub issue. The journal keeps the last {maxEntries} entries and drops anything older than {maxAgeDays} days.
diagnostics_no_db_body: Errors are journalled in your local database — click "Choose DB" in the header to start recording them.
diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: All {count} recorded errors will be deleted from this device. Export them first if you plan to report a bug.
diagnostics_report_body_prefix: This opens a new, pre-filled issue on
diagnostics_report_body_suffix: in a new tab. Below is exactly what would be sent — nothing else leaves your device, and you can still edit or abandon the issue there.

db_download_body: Download a full copy of your database (collection + all card lists). A one-off snapshot — for a file that keeps saving itself, link one under File DB.
db_restore_body_prefix: Restore your database from a previously downloaded copy. This

db_restore_link_hint_suffix: to keep this copy saving itself, or close this window.
db_no_fs_access: Auto-save to a linked file requires Chrome 86+, Edge 86+, or Safari 15.2+, so this browser has no File DB tab. Download and restore copies here instead.
db_create_body: Create a new empty database. All existing data will be cleared.
db_export_intro: Export your collection to share with other tools and services.
db_export_csv_hint: One column per field, opens in a spreadsheet, and imports back into this app.

db_data_safe: Your data is safe in the browser.

db_note_body: You can always export or import your data later using the application controls.
db_restore_confirm_suffix: your {lists} and {cards} with the contents of this file.

db_create_confirm_unlink: Your linked file "{name}" will be unlinked. The file itself won't be deleted, but it will no longer sync with the app.
db_create_confirm_warning: This action cannot be undone. Make sure you have a backup if needed.
import_error_foreign_app: This file was exported by "{app}", not {appName}. Nothing was changed.
import_error_not_an_export: This is not an {appName} export — it contains no card lists or collection. Nothing was changed.
import_error_unsupported_version: This file is export format version {version}; this app reads {supported}. Update the app before restoring. Nothing was changed.
import_error_truncated_lists_one: This file looks incomplete: it declares {declared} card list but contains {actual}. Nothing was changed.
import_error_truncated_lists_other: This file looks incomplete: it declares {declared} card lists but contains {actual}. Nothing was changed.
import_error_truncated_cards_one: This file looks incomplete: it declares {declared} collection card but contains {actual}. Nothing was changed.
import_error_truncated_cards_other: This file looks incomplete: it declares {declared} collection cards but contains {actual}. Nothing was changed.
import_error_unrecognised_format: Unrecognised file format. Please choose a .yjs or .json file exported from this app. Nothing was changed.
import_error_empty_payload: This file contains no card lists and no collection cards, so restoring from it would erase your data and put nothing back. Nothing was changed — use "Create New Database" if you meant to start over.
import_url_no_deck_id: Could not extract deck ID from Archidekt URL
import_url_archidekt_unreachable: Could not reach Archidekt API (likely blocked by CORS). Try exporting the deck as a text file from Archidekt and importing the file instead.
import_url_archidekt_status: Archidekt API returned {status}. Check that the deck is public.
import_url_moxfield: Moxfield deck URLs cannot be imported: Moxfield has no public API. In Moxfield, use "Export" to download the deck as a text file, then import it from the File tab (or paste it into the Text tab).
import_url_unsupported: Unsupported URL. Only Archidekt deck URLs can be imported. Any other deck site: export the deck as a text file and use the File or Text tab.

error_not_found_body: The address you followed doesn't lead anywhere in this app. Nothing was lost — your lists and collection live in your browser, untouched.
